product.title: Lower East Side Food Tour: Iconic Eats & the American Dream
product.description: Discover the rich cultural tapestry of New York's Lower East Side on this small-group tour. Sample delicious snacks while learning about the diverse ethnical groups that have shaped this historic neighborhood. From the iconic Lower East Side, China Town to Little Italy; Chinese dumplings to Italian pizza, enjoy fascinating insights as you eat your way around the LES.
highlights: Sample some classic NYC foods (Chinese dumplings, knish, empanada, and artisanal cheeses)
See the Lower East Side, Chinatown, and Little Italy up close on a walking tour
Stroll through bustling markets, narrow alleyways, and hidden corners while hearing stories of struggle, resilience, and the American Dream on a small-group tour
Leave the navigation to your guide and avoid getting lost in NYC
inclusions: Sample four iconic NYC dishes (may include dumplings, pizza, knish, empanada, and more)
Stroll through the Lower East Side, Chinatown & Little Italy
See historic NYC sites, including 100-year-old bakeries, churches, and neighborhood landmarks
Explore stories and cultural heritage that shaped these famous neighborhoods
Follow a friendly local English-speaking guide who’s passionate about food and history
Get insider tips on what else to eat, see, and experience during your stay in New York

start.description: 26 Canal St (Little Canal Cafe) In front of Little Canal Café, 26 Canal St, New York, NY 10002, United States.

end.description: Your tour ends in the heart of the Lower East Side neighborhood (New York, NY 10002).

product.itinerarySummary: Today, the Lower East Side is crammed with bars, clubs, and trendy restaurants. But if you know where to look, you can find very edible remnants of its intriguing past.
